action.objective: Verify d2d4 as the leading candidate at full depth 4 before committing.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search suggested d2d4 (score 64, exact, PV d2d4 exd4 Nxd4) as the strongest root, but it was never individually verified. Per the contract, I now run exactly one single-candidate analysis on d2d4 using the reserved verification allowance. Note the top rivals (c3b5, e2e4, b2b4) are bound=upper, so their scores are not reliable ties; d2d4's exact bound and 2.Nxd4 recapture centralize a knight and open lines for c1/Queen. 2...exd4 3.Nxd4 is a sound Sveshnikov-style recovery, though Black replies like ...Bb4+/...Nf6 need checking. This action will reveal Black's best reply, mate safety, and any tactical refutation before I commit.
